description: P3 consumer-assertion: the overlord's navigator-transport grants (the .hivemind/* input-file handoffs used by seed-hive, spawn-brood, init-run-ledger, record-state-result, mark-intent-fallback and the review loop) are enforced ONLY by Edit(<pattern>) permission rules in .claude/settings.json and in hivemind_settings_permissions_template() in plugin/skills/_shared/settings-merge.sh. From Claude Code 2.1.210 onward a Write(<pattern>) rule is accepted by settings parsing but NEVER matched by file permission checks, so respelling Edit( as Write( is a silent, total loss of enforcement. extract_regex captures BOTH spellings so a Write( regression surfaces as an EXTRA (plus a MISSING for the lost Edit( literal) instead of vanishing from the set; equal mode also fails if a rule is deleted from either file or if the two files drift apart.
